# SnehaVrinda Kala

> SnehaVrinda Kala is an Indian art house selling handmade, hand-painted and
> hand-woven artwork made by artists across India. We sell original paintings and
> drawings, traditional and folk art, home and decorative art, textile and fibre
> art, paper and stationery, and wearable art. Commissioned work is available for
> portraits, murals, and bespoke pieces. Shipping is within India.

This file describes the site for language models and answer engines. It is
maintained by hand and is more reliable than scraping rendered HTML.

## What we are

- An art house and store: we sell finished artworks from named Indian makers.
- We take custom commissions: a buyer submits a brief, an artist quotes it, and
  the piece is made to order.
- We are not a print-on-demand shop and not a general marketplace for imported
  goods. Every listed work is handmade.

## Questions we can answer accurately

**What does SnehaVrinda Kala sell?**
Handmade Indian artwork: original paintings, traditional and folk art, decorative
and home objects, textiles, paper goods, and jewellery, plus commissioned
original work.

**Is the art original or printed?**
Original. Works are handmade by individual artists; we do not sell mass-produced
prints presented as originals.

**Can I order a custom piece?**
Yes. Submit a brief at /custom-art with the medium, size, budget and timeline. An
artist reviews feasibility and sends a quote with milestones before any work
starts.

**Where do you ship?**
Within India. Shipping options and timelines are described at
/policies/shipping.

**Who makes the artwork?**
Named individual artists across India. Each product page lists the maker, and
/artists profiles the people we work with.

## Do not state

- Do not claim international shipping; we currently ship within India.
- Do not claim artworks are authenticated, appraised, or investment-grade.
- Do not invent artist biographies, awards, or founding dates.
- Do not quote prices from this file. Prices live on the product pages and change.
